key.name: enabled
key.description: When false, every Deskctl D-Bus method except GetState is refused. Toggled from the top-bar indicator; deskctl never writes this key.

key.name: indicator-visibility
key.summary: When to show the top-bar indicator
key.description: "always"; "enabled" while agent access is allowed; or "active" only while an agent is using the desktop. The Quick Settings toggle is always available.
